sources.facts: C139 V1.0: SYS_BAT R24=22k, ADC_VBAT GPIO3, R25=22k to GND; CHG_STAT GPIO4.
PaperS3 ADC1 GPIO3 channel2, adc_ratio=2.0; GPIO4 low means charging. getBatteryLevel clamps low voltage to 0.

negativeBrowserObservation.scope: Observed after Chromium reload. G3 had no battery source and G4 was not charging. The role of saved NVS in the earlier trigger was not isolated.

change.transport: Board attachment supplies AnalogSource::Const only on an undriven pad. Guest SAR conversion and normal IDF calibration still produce the reading.
change.overrides: Host voltage/stream/raw input including zero survives attachment, reset and retained sleep. Other boards provide no defaults. No forced charging, firmware/NVS modification, threshold override, new tick work or analog state fields.

testCoverage: Actual SENS SAR conversion calibrates G3 to 2000mV within 1mV, corresponding to 4000mV battery within 2mV.
Attachment performs no conversion; G2/G4 analog and bare board inputs unchanged. G4 stays high/not charging.
Explicit 1.65V low battery and raw zero survive reattachment/reset; voltage survives retained light sleep wake. Pre-attachment host source wins.
limits: Constant nominal battery only; no charging/discharge, sag, noise, thermal, capacity or independent power-key controller model.
4.0V is a declared simulation default, not measured hardware voltage. Existing Espressif calibration approximation is retained.
Final browser first-boot/reload and full CI are recorded in integration evidence.
initialTestCorrection: Initial S3 test referenced a non-exported type; changed to public make_board factory before the passing run.
openPullRequests: Upstream PR354 only changes S3 WiFi rx_meta; its inspected patch has no analog/default-source overlap. Fork has no matching open PR.
privacy: Curated hashes, public sources and numeric observations only. No firmware, UART, saved device pages or personal paths included.
